findings.observation: The mature medium-skinned woman remains unmistakably Corin through her broad oval full-cheeked face, sharply defined brows, aquiline nose, softly full closed mouth, steady adult gaze, earrings, and absence of a facial mark.

The evident soft middle and natural mass remain, but the summon’s tall 178 cm language is lost: shortened thick legs, compressed torso, broadened shoulders, and enlarged thigh mass make the derivative read short and stocky rather than tall soft-round.

Both arms and hands are visibly inflated relative to the summon: the forearms are shortened and thickened, and the large clenched fists replace the source’s relaxed natural cuff-checking hands, producing generic bulky chibi anatomy.
The black short textured crop preserves the dense curled front, asymmetric side length, swept part, shaved-side geometric treatment, and overall silhouette from the summon.

The marigold-green quilted architectural-lapel coat, fitted underlayer, rolled sleeves, tapered trousers, earrings, circular wrapped keepsake cord, bounded geometric hand/forearm tattoo family, medicine pouch, and polished ochre shoes remain legible and source-bound.

At original 1024×1536 resolution, topmost hair is about y=140, the chin about y=535, and the soles about y=1410; the complete head-and-hair unit therefore occupies only about 31 percent of standing height, roughly 3.2 heads total, below the strict 32 percent minimum and above the 3.1-head ceiling.
Exactly one full-body figure appears with the full hair silhouette, both hands, both legs, and both shoes entirely inside generous parchment margins and no duplicate anatomy.
The planted three-quarter ready-idle stance, asymmetric crop, raised empty hands, strong quilted-coat silhouette, tattoo, pouch, and separated feet read clearly at combat-icon scale without a weapon.

The character remains grounded in mortal quilted cloth, cord, pouch, tattoos, trousers, and shoes; no weapon, upgraded armor, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or extra subject appears.
